jcr:content.jcr:title: A thesis you cannot falsify is a preference.

master.title: A thesis you cannot falsify is a preference.
master.statement: Every position is taken with a written statement of what would have to be true, and what would prove it wrong.
master.rationale: The second half is the part that matters. Without it a thesis cannot fail, only disappoint, and a firm learns nothing from disappointment.
